judged_text: GET /groups/:name/members changes its wire contract with no versioning: the response goes from a bare JSON array to `{members: [...], meta: {...}}`, and the default limit drops from 200 (automatic groups) / unbounded (regular groups) to 50. Out-of-tree consumers — plugins or API scripts that parse the old top-level array with `response.map(...)` — break at runtime, and consumers relying on the full member list silently receive only the first 50 rows.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, ...)` (a bare top-level JSON array) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: { total, limit, offset } }` and also introduces pagination for all groups with `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` (previously regular groups were effectively unbounded and automatic groups defaulted to 200). In-tree JS is updated to call `/groups/:name/members.json` and read `result.members`/`result.meta`, but any external consumer expecting an array or full member list would indeed break or silently get only the first 50.
